subject.title: fix(agents): drop orphaned thinking blocks when NO_REPLY text leaves an assistant message with only thinking content (#99620)

question: Should this PR require redacted live Anthropic/runtime payload proof before merge, or is the current source-level normalizer proof enough for this provider-sensitive replay fix?
rationale: The source path and tests are strong, but the change is meant to prevent an external Anthropic 400 and deliberately drops persisted replay content, so automation should not choose the proof threshold or overlap strategy for maintainers.

options.title: Require live/runtime proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted Anthropic API output or runtime payload logs from this PR head showing the malformed replay is no longer sent.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Merge with the focused normalizer output and regression tests while explicitly accepting the unproven live-provider path.

options.title: Fold into broader replay branch
options.body: Carry this NO_REPLY guard and tests into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 if maintainers want one Anthropic replay-policy landing path.

recommendation.title: Require live/runtime proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Anthropic API output or runtime payload logs from this PR head showing the malformed replay is no longer sent.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available decision owner from the sampled history and PR discussion because the unresolved choice is proof threshold and replay-policy coordination, not a mechanical code fix.
